newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia vehicle sales increase in October - Astra.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia vehicle sales increase in October - Astra.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automotive maker PT Astra International said on Thursday the country's total vehicle sales increased to 30,193 units in October from 27,875 units in September.
A total of 35,623 vehicles were sold in October last year.
Astra said in a monthly statistical report passenger car sales rose by 11.37 percent to 3,016 units in October from 2,708 units in September.
It said commercial vehicle sales also improved by 8.94 percent to 26,705 units in October from 24,513 units in September.
A total of 472 vehicles were exported last month.
However, Astra's market share declined to 50.74 percent in October from 52.06 percent in September, and compared with 56.37 percent in October last year.

Astra did not include sales of the controversial Timor national car in its figures. Mohamad Ircham, spokesman of PT Timor Putra Nasional, the company controlled by President Suharto's son Hutomo Mandala Putra, told Reuters Timor had sold some 9,000 cars since the launching in July.
"We have imported 8,034 units from South Korea and some 4,000 units had been delivered to end users," Ircham said.

He said Timor would continue to import 4,000 units a month. The company has received tax and tariff breaks which allow it to sell its cars currently produced by South Korea's Kia Motors for about half the price of comparable vehicles from other companies.
The Astra statistics showed the fall in Astra's market share was due to to a slower growth in commercial vehicle sales.
Astra's commercial vehicle sales grew by 6.91 percent to 13,957 units in October from 13,055 units in September, against non-Astra sales growth of 11.26 percent last month.
Its passenger car sales grew by 15.86 percent to 986 units in October from 851 units in September, compared with non-Astra sales growth of 9.32 percent to 2,030 units in October.
Total vehicle sales, including exports, in the first 10 months of this year were 267,163 units against 319,765 units in the same period last year, Astra said.
Astra said Indonesian motorcycle sales amounted to 143,575 units in October, compared with 132,972 units in September, and against 98,983 units in October last year.
Astra, the agent for Japan's Honda, had a market share of 47.49 percent in October against 48 percent in September.
Total motorcycle sales in the first 10 months were 1,129,056 units against 815,924 units in the same 1995 period.
